name: Elder Care
description: Coordinate care for a loved one: a visit rotation, shared care tasks, appointment notes, and an observation log the whole care circle can see.

visits.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__visits WHERE date >= date(?, '-30 days') ORDER BY date ASC, time ASC

tasks.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__tasks WHERE completed_at = '' OR completed_at >= date(?, '-120 days') ORDER BY (status = 'done'), (due_date = ''), due_date ASC, created_at DESC

appointments.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__appointments WHERE date >= date(?, '-30 days') ORDER BY date ASC, time ASC

observations.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__observations WHERE observed_at >= date(?, '-120 days') ORDER BY observed_at DESC

profiles.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__profiles ORDER BY created_at ASC

add_task.title: Add a care task
add_task.description: File a task for the care circle when another app records something that needs following up — a prescription to collect, a form to return, a follow-up after an appointment.

suggested_automations.title: File a care task when an appointment goes on the calendar
suggested_automations.description: An appointment usually carries a chore with it — confirm the ride, collect the paperwork. The task lands unassigned so whoever picks it up claims it themselves rather than being volunteered by a rule.

detail.value: Follow up before this date — confirm transport and paperwork.

views.title: Care profile
views.description: What everyone helping should know about each person: where they live, their doctor and pharmacy, conditions, allergies, diet, mobility and what a normal day looks like.

source.query: WITH f AS (SELECT id AS profile_id, created_at AS created_at, 1 AS sort_order, 'Date of birth' AS field, born_on AS detail FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 2, 'Where they live', residence FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 3, 'Primary doctor', primary_doctor FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 4, 'Pharmacy', pharmacy FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 5, 'Conditions and diagnoses', diagnoses FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 6, 'Allergies', allergies_note FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 7, 'Diet', diet FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 8, 'Mobility and daily help', mobility FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 9, 'Memory and thinking', cognition FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 10, 'Preferences and routines', preferences FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '' UNION ALL SELECT id, created_at, 11, 'A normal day', baseline FROM app_elder_care__profiles WHERE archived_at = '') SELECT p.name AS person, f.field AS field, f.detail AS detail FROM f JOIN app_elder_care__profiles p ON p.id = f.profile_id WHERE f.detail <> '' ORDER BY f.created_at, f.profile_id, f.sort_order

views.title: Readings
views.description: Blood pressure, weight and other readings the family recorded, newest first within each kind. A blood pressure has two numbers.

source.query: SELECT p.name AS person, CASE v.kind WHEN 'bp' THEN 'Blood pressure' WHEN 'pulse' THEN 'Pulse' WHEN 'weight' THEN 'Weight' WHEN 'glucose' THEN 'Blood sugar' WHEN 'temp' THEN 'Temperature' WHEN 'oxygen' THEN 'Oxygen' WHEN 'sleep' THEN 'Sleep' WHEN 'appetite' THEN 'Appetite' WHEN 'pain' THEN 'Pain' ELSE v.kind END AS measure, (CASE WHEN v.measured_date = '' THEN substr(v.measured_at, 1, 10) ELSE v.measured_date END) AS day, v.measured_at AS taken, v.value AS value, v.value2 AS second, v.unit AS unit, v.note AS note, v.recorded_by AS recorded_by FROM app_elder_care__vitals v JOIN app_elder_care__profiles p ON p.id = v.profile_id WHERE p.archived_at = '' AND (CASE WHEN v.measured_date = '' THEN substr(v.measured_at, 1, 10) ELSE v.measured_date END) >= :range_start AND (CASE WHEN v.measured_date = '' THEN substr(v.measured_at, 1, 10) ELSE v.measured_date END) <= :range_end ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id, v.kind, v.measured_at DESC

views.title: Readings they logged themselves
views.description: Readings a person recorded for themselves, newest first within each kind.

source.query: SELECT p.name AS person, CASE v.kind WHEN 'bp' THEN 'Blood pressure' WHEN 'pulse' THEN 'Pulse' WHEN 'weight' THEN 'Weight' WHEN 'glucose' THEN 'Blood sugar' WHEN 'temp' THEN 'Temperature' WHEN 'oxygen' THEN 'Oxygen' WHEN 'sleep' THEN 'Sleep' WHEN 'appetite' THEN 'Appetite' WHEN 'pain' THEN 'Pain' ELSE v.kind END AS measure, (CASE WHEN v.measured_date = '' THEN substr(v.measured_at, 1, 10) ELSE v.measured_date END) AS day, v.measured_at AS taken, v.value AS value, v.value2 AS second, v.unit AS unit, v.note AS note FROM app_elder_care__own_vitals v JOIN app_elder_care__profiles p ON p.member_id = v.member_id WHERE p.archived_at = '' AND (CASE WHEN v.measured_date = '' THEN substr(v.measured_at, 1, 10) ELSE v.measured_date END) >= :range_start AND (CASE WHEN v.measured_date = '' THEN substr(v.measured_at, 1, 10) ELSE v.measured_date END) <= :range_end ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id, v.kind, v.measured_at DESC

views.title: Observation log
views.description: What the care circle noticed, newest first. Entries that name nobody are listed last.

source.query: SELECT p.name AS person, (CASE WHEN o.observed_date = '' THEN substr(o.observed_at, 1, 10) ELSE o.observed_date END) AS day, o.observed_at AS noted, CASE o.category WHEN 'general' THEN 'General' WHEN 'health' THEN 'Health' WHEN 'mood' THEN 'Mood' WHEN 'meds' THEN 'Medication' ELSE o.category END AS category, o.note AS note, o.member_id AS noted_by FROM app_elder_care__observations o LEFT JOIN app_elder_care__profiles p ON p.id = o.profile_id WHERE (o.profile_id = '' OR p.archived_at = '') AND (CASE WHEN o.observed_date = '' THEN substr(o.observed_at, 1, 10) ELSE o.observed_date END) >= :range_start AND (CASE WHEN o.observed_date = '' THEN substr(o.observed_at, 1, 10) ELSE o.observed_date END) <= :range_end ORDER BY (p.created_at IS NULL), p.created_at, p.id, o.observed_at DESC

views.title: Appointments
views.description: Appointments in the period, newest first, with the provider and who went along. Entries that name nobody are listed last.

source.query: SELECT p.name AS person, a.date AS day, a.time AS at_time, a.title AS appointment, a.provider AS provider, a.location AS location, a.notes AS notes, a.accompanied_by_id AS taken_by FROM app_elder_care__appointments a LEFT JOIN app_elder_care__profiles p ON p.id = a.profile_id WHERE (a.profile_id = '' OR p.archived_at = '') AND a.date >= :range_start AND a.date <= :range_end ORDER BY (p.created_at IS NULL), p.created_at, p.id, a.date DESC, a.time DESC

SELECT id AS id, title AS title, CASE WHEN time = '' THEN date ELSE date || 'T' || time END AS when_at, NULLIF(provider, '') AS subtitle, NULLIF(accompanied_by_id, '') AS member_id FROM app_elder_care__appointments WHERE date = :today ORDER BY time LIMIT 20

SELECT id AS id, title AS title, due_date AS when_at, (status = 'done') AS done, NULLIF(detail, '') AS subtitle, NULLIF(assignee_id, '') AS member_id FROM app_elder_care__tasks WHERE due_date = :today ORDER BY status, created_at LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_elder_care__tasks WHERE status = 'open' LIMIT 1
